The working-tree diff against 729f9d6 was inspected: only files named in reports 21, 22 and 23 changed, data/index.ts, lib/persona.ts, components/avatar and every design section 9 do-not-touch file are unchanged, and new content has no em dash or machine-local path.

Campus and destinations: from spawn QA walks on foot without jumping to the Project Lab, Skills Workshop and Contact Tower on the real GPU, each recognizable from the plaza with a readable sign (screenshot from spawn), the ravine fall respawns at the plaza, every main-route slope and step is walkable, and the deliberate Lab-at-screen-left handedness matches the spec's 'Lab to the left' from spawn.
